title: Practical Estimation of Trotter Error for Hamiltonian Simulation
summary: Trotter product formulas are a leading approach for Hamiltonian simulation on quantum computers, yet their practical performance has remained difficult to assess due to the challenge of accurately estimating the Trotter error. In this work, we develop new theoretical results, algorithms, and software tools that advance the state-of-the-art in Trotter error estimation by orders of magnitude in both scale and accuracy.
